title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1 fail to enforce the configured GitLab…
description: Certain Mattermost versions (11.7.x up to 11.7.11, 11.10.x up to 11.10.2, and 11.11.x up to 11.11.1) do not properly enforce GitLab group or namespace restrictions on the permalink code-preview feature and the {{get_projects}} MCP tool. This flaw allows an authenticated user with a connected GitLab account to access repository file content or project metadata from projects outside the intended restricted group.
